", "t": [["write_file", "{"path":"D:\\Projects\\local_ai\\strata-lab\\runs\\work\\hermes\\lru_ttl-1794053108\\lru_ttl.py","content":"import time\nfrom collections import OrderedDict\n\n\nclass LRUCache:\n    def __init__(self, capacity, ttl=None, clock=time.monotonic):\n        if capacity < 1:\n            raise ValueError(\"capacity must be at least 1\")\n        self.capacity = capacity\n        self.ttl = ttl\n        self.clock = clock\n        # key -> (value, expires_at or None); insertion order = LRU -> MRU\n        self._data = OrderedDict()\n\n    def _expired(self, key, now):\n        _, expires_at = self._data[key]\n        return expires_at is not None and now >= expires_at\n\n    def _purge_expired(self, now):\n        for key in [k for k in self._data if self._expired(k, now)]:\n            del self._data[key]\n\n    def get(self, key, default=None):\n        now = self.clock()\n        if key not in self._data:\n            return default\n        if self._expired(key, now):\n            del self._data[key]\n            return default\n        self._data.move_to_end(key)\n        return self._data[key][0]\n\n    def put(self, key, value):\n        now = self.clock()\n        self._purge_expired(now)\n        expires_at = None if self.ttl is None else now + self.ttl\n        if key in self._data:\n            del self._data[key]\n        self._data[key] = (value, expires_at)\n        while len(self._data) > self.capacity:\n            self._data.popitem(last=False)\n\n    def __len__(self):\n        self._purge_expired(self.clock())\n        return len(self._data)\n\n    def __contains__(self, key):\n        now = self.clock()\n        if key not in self._data:\n            return False\n        if self._expired(key, now):\n            del self._data[key]\n            return False\n        return True\n"}"]]}
